title: Practice 5: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: She has already left the office.
exercises.why: **ушла** — past tense (feminine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: It hasn't come to that yet.
exercises.why: **дошло** — past tense (neuter) of дойти: perfective (imperfective partner: доходить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: She gave me a ride home.
exercises.why: **довезла** — past tense (feminine) of довезти: perfective (imperfective partner: довозить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: The airplane went into a spin.
exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom walked away from the restaurant.
exercises.why: **ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A cat came out from under the desk.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: It's too late now, Lusya!
exercises.why: **ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Carlos entered his room.
exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: She got off her bike.
exercises.why: **слезла** — past tense (feminine) of слезть: perfective (imperfective partner: слезать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The soldiers left for the front.
exercises.why: **ушли** — past tense (plural) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Who led sheep here?
exercises.why: **привёл** — past tense (masculine) of привести: perfective (imperfective partner: приводить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We didn't reach the summit.
exercises.why: **дошли** — past tense (plural) of дойти: perfective (imperfective partner: доходить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: The ship set sail for Bombay.
exercises.why: **отплыл** — past tense (masculine) of отплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: отплывать).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: I converted to Christianity.
exercises.why: **перешёл** — past tense (masculine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: She is gone shopping.
exercises.why: **ушла** — past tense (feminine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: One of her shoes dropped off.
exercises.why: **слетела** — past tense (feminine) of слететь: perfective (imperfective partner: слетать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Tom barely escaped.
exercises.why: **унёс** — past tense (masculine) of унести: perfective (imperfective partner: уносить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Are you in debt yet?
exercises.why: **влез** — past tense (masculine) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Adriano retired.
exercises.why: **ушел** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I dropped her off at the airport.
exercises.why: **довёз** — past tense (masculine) of довезти: perfective (imperfective partner: довозить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
